does: Pours a liquid or a loose sauce onto food laid in a dish, slowly and from the side, so that it settles into the gaps without washing off the top.
how: Lay the food out in the dish first, in the way it is to be served.
Pour from low down near the rim, in a thin steady stream, and not straight onto the middle.
Stop when the liquid has reached the level the dish asks for. Leave the top of the food showing if it is to brown.
Tap the dish gently so that the liquid settles into every gap.

cues.text: The liquid stands at one level all round, and the tops of the pieces show above it.

mistakes.mistake: Pouring from high up, which splashes and washes off the seasoning or the topping.
mistakes.fix: Pour low, from the side, in a thin stream.

mistakes.mistake: Filling the dish to the brim, so that it spills in the oven.
mistakes.fix: Leave a gap below the rim.

comes_after.why: The food is laid out in the dish first, and the liquid goes over it last.
